    Anatomy Paper-I, Part II • General Anatomy, Cell Biology & Elementary Genetics
    ★★★
    Describe the structure of a cell membrane with a labeled diagram according to the fluid mosaic model. Mention the functions of cell membrane proteins.
    40th BCS44th BCS 10 Marks
    QID: #1
    📚 Reference: BD Chaurasia's Human Anatomy 8th ed. / Snell's Clinical Anatomy
    CLINICAL CONCEPT & FLOWCHART SCHEMATIC: GENERAL ANATOMY, CELL BIOLOGY & ELEMENTARY GENETICS
    Etiology & Structural Basis ➔ Pathophysiology & Presentation ➔ Diagnostic Tests & Gold Standard ➔ Evidence-Based Management
    1. Anatomical / Physiological / Pathological Basis:

    Detailed examination of General Anatomy, Cell Biology & Elementary Genetics according to standard textbooks (BD Chaurasia's Human Anatomy 8th ed. / Snell's Clinical Anatomy). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - General Anatomy, Cell Biology & Elementary Genetics টপিকের মূল ভাব: বিসিএস লিখিত পরীক্ষায় এই প্রশ্নের উত্তর লেখার সময় সুন্দর পয়েন্ট ও সাব-হেডিং ব্যবহার করুন।
    - পরীক্ষকের প্রত্যাশা: অ্যানাটমি বা ফিজিওলজি হলে অবশ্যই একটি পরিষ্কার চিহ্নিত চিত্র (Labeled Diagram) আঁকবেন; মেডিসিন বা সার্জারি হলে ধাপে ধাপে ট্রিটমেন্ট প্রটোকল লিখবেন।
    - নম্বর তোলার কৌশল: মূল মেডিকেল টার্মিনোলজি ও ড্রাগের নাম ইংরেজিতে বোল্ড করে উপস্থাপন করলে সর্বোচ্চ নম্বর পাওয়া যায়।

    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

    PARKLAND (BAXTER) RESUSCITATION FORMULA
    Total Fluid (24 hrs) = 4 mL × Weight (kg) × % TBSA Burned (Ringer's Lactate)
    1st 8 Hours: 50% of total | Next 16 Hours: Remaining 50%
    1. Calculation of Burn Percentage (Wallace Rule of Nines):

    Head/Neck = 9%, Anterior Trunk = 18%, Posterior Trunk = 18%, Each Upper Limb = 9% (x2=18%), Each Lower Limb = 18% (x2=36%), Perineum = 1%. Total = 100%.

    2. Parkland Formula Resuscitation:
    • Fluid of Choice: Ringer's Lactate.
    • Formula: 4 mL × Body Weight (kg) × % TBSA burned.
    • Administration Schedule: Give 50% in the first 8 hours (calculated from the exact time of injury), and the remaining 50% over the next 16 hours.
    • Monitoring Endpoint: Maintain adult urine output at 0.5 to 1.0 mL/kg/hour (30–50 mL/hr).
    3. Early & Late Complications:

    Hypovolemic shock, Inhalation injury, Burn wound sepsis (Pseudomonas), Curling's stress ulcer, Contractures, Marjolin's ulcer (SCC).

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও অংক করার ট্রিকস:
    - ৮ ঘণ্টার হিসাব: রোগী হাসপাতালে আসার সময় থেকে নয়, দুর্ঘটনা ঘটার মুহূর্ত থেকে ৮ ঘণ্টার মধ্যে মোট ফ্লুইডের অর্ধেক শেষ করতে হবে!
    - সেরা ফ্লুইড: সব সময় Ringer's Lactate (হার্টম্যান সল্যুশন)। Normal Saline দিলে এসিডোসিস হতে পারে।
    - মনিটরিং: প্রস্রাব মেপে দেখতে হবে ঘণ্টায় ৩০–৫০ মিলি হচ্ছে কি না।

    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    Describe the pharmacological actions, clinical uses, and toxic signs of Atropine. How is organophosphorus compound poisoning treated with Atropine and Pralidoxime?
    41st BCS45th BCS 10 Marks
    QID: #142
    📚 Reference: Parikh's Textbook of Medical Jurisprudence & Toxicology / Davidson's Medicine Ch. 9
    OPP CHOLINERGIC CRISIS & ATROPINIZATION
    Toxidrome: D-U-M-B-E-L-S
    Atropinized: Clear Lungs + HR > 80 + Dilated Pupils
    1. Pathogenesis & Clinical Features:
    • Mechanism: Irreversible phosphorylation and inhibition of Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) leading to toxic acetylcholine accumulation.
    • Muscarinic Toxidrome (DUMBELS): Diarrhea, Urination, Miosis (pinpoint pupils), Bronchorrhea & Bradycardia, Emesis, Lacrimation, Salivation (froth at mouth).
    • Nicotinic: Muscle fasciculations, muscle twitching, flaccid weakness.
    2. Emergency Management:
    • Decontamination: Strip contaminated clothes; wash body with soap and water; secure personal protection (PPE).
    • Airway & Oxygen: Clear secretions by suctioning; provide high-flow O₂ before atropine to prevent ventricular fibrillation.
    • Atropine Protocol: IV Atropine 1.8–3 mg stat bolus, double the dose every 5 minutes (3 ➔ 6 ➔ 12 ➔ 24 mg) until fully atropinized.
    • Signs of Full Atropinization: Clear chest (no rhonchi/bronchorrhea), dry axillae/mouth, heart rate > 80–100 bpm, dilated pupils.
    • Cholinesterase Reactivator: Pralidoxime (2-PAM) 1–2 g IV in 100 mL NS over 30 min, then 8 mg/kg/hr infusion.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ইমার্জেন্সি গোল্ড:
    - DUMBELS লক্ষণ: চোখে পিনপয়েন্ট পিউপিল, মুখে লালা/ফেনা, অতিরিক্ত ঘাম, পেটে মোচড় দিয়ে পাতলা পায়খানা।
    - সতর্কতা: হাইপোক্সিক (অক্সিজেনশূন্য) হার্টে হুট করে এট্রোপিন দিলে ভেন্ট্রিকুলার ফিব্রিলেশন হয়ে রোগী সাথে সাথে মারা যাবে! আগে সাকশন ও ১০০% অক্সিজেন, তারপর এট্রোপিন।
    - এট্রোপিনাইজেশন সাইন: বুক শব্দমুক্ত হওয়া (ফুসফুসে আর কোনো ঘড়ঘড় শব্দ না থাকা) সবচেয়ে প্রধান সাইন।

    44th BCS 6 Marks
    QID: #143
    📚 Reference: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 26th ed., Ch. 4 / National EPI Guidelines Bangladesh
    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

    1. Anatomical / Physiological / Pathological Basis:

    Detailed examination of Central Nervous System & Analgesics according to standard textbooks (KD Tripathi's Essentials of Medical Pharmacology 8th ed. / Katzung). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    📚 Reference: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 26th ed., Ch. 4 / National EPI Guidelines Bangladesh
    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

    - পরীক্ষকের প্রত্যাশা: অ্যানাটমি বা ফিজিওলজি হলে অবশ্যই একটি পরিষ্কার চিহ্নিত চিত্র (Labeled Diagram) আঁকবেন; মেডিসিন বা সার্জারি হলে ধাপে ধাপে ট্রিটমেন্ট প্রটোকল লিখবেন।

    ACUTE STEMI EMERGENCY TIMELINE
    0-10m: ECG + MONA Protocol ➔ 10-60m: Dual Antiplatelet + Anticoagulation ➔ ≤90m: Primary PCI vs Streptokinase
    1. Diagnosis & Bedside Investigations:
    • Diagnosis: Acute ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI).
    • Immediate Tests: 12-lead ECG (ST elevation ≥ 1 mm in ≥ 2 contiguous leads, or ≥ 2 mm in V2-V3), Cardiac Troponin I/T, CK-MB, bedside Echo, serum electrolytes, serum creatinine, lipid profile.
    2. Step-by-Step Emergency Management:
    • MONA-B Resuscitation: Oxygen (only if SpO₂ < 90%), Sublingual GTN 0.5 mg (avoid in RV infarction/hypotension), IV Morphine 3–5 mg + Metoclopramide 10 mg, Aspirin 300 mg chewed, Ticagrelor 180 mg or Clopidogrel 300–600 mg stat.
    • Reperfusion: Primary PCI (door-to-balloon ≤ 90 min) OR Thrombolysis with IV Streptokinase 1.5 million IU in 100 mL NS over 60 min (door-to-needle ≤ 30 min).
    • Adjunctive Pharmacotherapy: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC 12-hrly, Atorvastatin 80 mg daily, Oral Beta-blocker (Metoprolol 25–50 mg) and ACE-inhibitor (Ramipril 2.5 mg) within 24 hours.
    3. Early Complications:

    Ventricular Fibrillation/VT, Cardiogenic Shock, Acute Mitral Regurgitation, VSR, and Cardiac Tamponade.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - টাইম ইজ মাসল: এমআই-এর রোগী আসা মাত্রই ৩টি ডিসপিরিন (Aspirin 300 mg) চিবিয়ে খেতে দিন + Clopidogrel 4টি (300 mg) + Atorvastatin 80 mg।
    - সতর্কতা: Inferior wall STEMI-তে রাইট ভেন্ট্রিকল আক্রান্ত থাকলে ভুলেও Nitroglycerin দেওয়া যাবে না! দিলে মারাত্মক প্রেশার কমে কার্ডিওজেনিক শক হতে পারে।
    - বাংলাদেশে প্রথম চিকিৎসা: জেলা/উপজেলা লেভেলে PCI না থাকায় Streptokinase 1.5 million IU ইনফিউশন প্রধান উত্তর।

    Ventricular Fibrillation/VT, Cardiogenic Shock, Acute Mitral Regurgitation, VSR, and Cardiac Tamponade.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - টাইম ইজ মাসল: এমআই-এর রোগী আসা মাত্রই ৩টি ডিসপিরিন (Aspirin 300 mg) চিবিয়ে খেতে দিন + Clopidogrel 4টি (300 mg) + Atorvastatin 80 mg।
    - সতর্কতা: Inferior wall STEMI-তে রাইট ভেন্ট্রিকল আক্রান্ত থাকলে ভুলেও Nitroglycerin দেওয়া যাবে না! দিলে মারাত্মক প্রেশার কমে কার্ডিওজেনিক শক হতে পারে।
    - বাংলাদেশে প্রথম চিকিৎসা: জেলা/উপজেলা লেভেলে PCI না থাকায় Streptokinase 1.5 million IU ইনফিউশন প্রধান উত্তর।

In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.

    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    Pathology & Microbiology Paper-II, Part II • Systemic Pathology
    ★★★★★
    Describe the morphology and microscopic changes of Acute Myocardial Infarction at various time intervals after ischemia. Mention the complications of AMI.
    41st BCS45th BCS 10 Marks
    QID: #190
    📚 Reference: Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine 24th ed., Ch. 18 (Cardiovascular Disease)
    ACUTE STEMI EMERGENCY TIMELINE
    0-10m: ECG + MONA Protocol ➔ 10-60m: Dual Antiplatelet + Anticoagulation ➔ ≤90m: Primary PCI vs Streptokinase
    1. Diagnosis & Bedside Investigations:
    • Diagnosis: Acute ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI).
    • Immediate Tests: 12-lead ECG (ST elevation ≥ 1 mm in ≥ 2 contiguous leads, or ≥ 2 mm in V2-V3), Cardiac Troponin I/T, CK-MB, bedside Echo, serum electrolytes, serum creatinine, lipid profile.
    2. Step-by-Step Emergency Management:
    • MONA-B Resuscitation: Oxygen (only if SpO₂ < 90%), Sublingual GTN 0.5 mg (avoid in RV infarction/hypotension), IV Morphine 3–5 mg + Metoclopramide 10 mg, Aspirin 300 mg chewed, Ticagrelor 180 mg or Clopidogrel 300–600 mg stat.
    • Reperfusion: Primary PCI (door-to-balloon ≤ 90 min) OR Thrombolysis with IV Streptokinase 1.5 million IU in 100 mL NS over 60 min (door-to-needle ≤ 30 min).
    • Adjunctive Pharmacotherapy: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC 12-hrly, Atorvastatin 80 mg daily, Oral Beta-blocker (Metoprolol 25–50 mg) and ACE-inhibitor (Ramipril 2.5 mg) within 24 hours.
    3. Early Complications:

    Ventricular Fibrillation/VT, Cardiogenic Shock, Acute Mitral Regurgitation, VSR, and Cardiac Tamponade.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - টাইম ইজ মাসল: এমআই-এর রোগী আসা মাত্রই ৩টি ডিসপিরিন (Aspirin 300 mg) চিবিয়ে খেতে দিন + Clopidogrel 4টি (300 mg) + Atorvastatin 80 mg।
    - সতর্কতা: Inferior wall STEMI-তে রাইট ভেন্ট্রিকল আক্রান্ত থাকলে ভুলেও Nitroglycerin দেওয়া যাবে না! দিলে মারাত্মক প্রেশার কমে কার্ডিওজেনিক শক হতে পারে।
    - বাংলাদেশে প্রথম চিকিৎসা: জেলা/উপজেলা লেভেলে PCI না থাকায় Streptokinase 1.5 million IU ইনফিউশন প্রধান উত্তর।

    1. Anatomical / Physiological / Pathological Basis:

    Detailed examination of Virology according to standard textbooks (Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease 10th ed. / Jawetz Medical Microbiology). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    Describe Dengue Virus: Serotypes, transmission vector, pathogenesis of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (antibody-dependent enhancement), and laboratory diagnosis (NS1 antigen, IgM/IgG).
    41st BCS45th BCS 12 Marks
    QID: #204
    📚 Reference: National Guidelines for Clinical Management of Dengue Syndrome Bangladesh / WHO
    DENGUE CLINICAL PHASES & FLUID REGIMEN
    Febrile Phase (Days 1-4) ➔ Critical Phase (Days 4-7, Plasma Leak) ➔ Recovery Phase (Fluid Reabsorption)
    1. Clinical Phases & Warning Signs:
    • Critical Phase: Occurs when fever subsides (around Day 4–6), lasting 24–48 hours; characterized by capillary leakage leading to hemoconcentration and shock.
    • Warning Signs: Severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleeding, lethargy/restlessness, hepatomegaly > 2 cm, rising Hematocrit (HCT ≥ 20% increase) with rapid drop in platelets (< 100,000/μL).
    2. Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS) Fluid Resuscitation Protocol:
    • Compensated Shock: Start IV Ringer's Lactate / 0.9% Normal Saline at 5–10 mL/kg/hr over 1 hour. If improving, reduce gradually to 5–7 ➔ 3–5 ➔ 2–3 mL/kg/hr.
    • Decompensated / Hypotensive Shock: Bolus 10–20 mL/kg of crystalloid over 15–30 minutes. If no improvement, infuse 10–20 mL/kg of colloid (Dextran 40 / 6% HES).
    • Caution: Stop fluids immediately in recovery phase to prevent pulmonary edema!
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও চিকিৎসকের সতর্কতা:
    - সবচেয়ে বিপজ্জনক সময়: যখন জ্বর ছাড়ে (Day 4–6), তখনই ক্রcritical phase শুরু হয়! প্লাজমা লিক হয়ে রক্তনালী শুকিয়ে শক হয়।
    - হেমাটোক্রিট (HCT) হলো কম্পাস: ডেঙ্গুতে প্লাটিলেটের চেয়েও হেমাটোক্রিট বেশি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। HCT বাড়লে ফ্লুইড বাড়াতে হবে, কমলে কমাতে হবে।
    - কখন ফ্লুইড বন্ধ করবেন? ৪৮ ঘণ্টা ক্রিটিক্যাল ফেইজ পার হলে রোগী সুস্থ হতে শুরু করে, তখন অতিরিক্ত স্যালাইন দিলে ফুসফুসে পানি জমে (Pulmonary Edema) রোগী মারা যেতে পারে।

    ★★★★
    Describe Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV): Structure, replication cycle, modes of transmission, criteria for diagnosing AIDS, and opportunistic infections.
    43rd BCS 10 Marks
    QID: #205
    📚 Reference: Parikh's Textbook of Medical Jurisprudence & Toxicology / Davidson's Medicine Ch. 9
    OPP CHOLINERGIC CRISIS & ATROPINIZATION
    Toxidrome: D-U-M-B-E-L-S
    Atropinized: Clear Lungs + HR > 80 + Dilated Pupils
    1. Pathogenesis & Clinical Features:
    • Mechanism: Irreversible phosphorylation and inhibition of Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) leading to toxic acetylcholine accumulation.
    • Muscarinic Toxidrome (DUMBELS): Diarrhea, Urination, Miosis (pinpoint pupils), Bronchorrhea & Bradycardia, Emesis, Lacrimation, Salivation (froth at mouth).
    • Nicotinic: Muscle fasciculations, muscle twitching, flaccid weakness.
    2. Emergency Management:
    • Decontamination: Strip contaminated clothes; wash body with soap and water; secure personal protection (PPE).
    • Airway & Oxygen: Clear secretions by suctioning; provide high-flow O₂ before atropine to prevent ventricular fibrillation.
    • Atropine Protocol: IV Atropine 1.8–3 mg stat bolus, double the dose every 5 minutes (3 ➔ 6 ➔ 12 ➔ 24 mg) until fully atropinized.
    • Signs of Full Atropinization: Clear chest (no rhonchi/bronchorrhea), dry axillae/mouth, heart rate > 80–100 bpm, dilated pupils.
    • Cholinesterase Reactivator: Pralidoxime (2-PAM) 1–2 g IV in 100 mL NS over 30 min, then 8 mg/kg/hr infusion.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ইমার্জেন্সি গোল্ড:
    - DUMBELS লক্ষণ: চোখে পিনপয়েন্ট পিউপিল, মুখে লালা/ফেনা, অতিরিক্ত ঘাম, পেটে মোচড় দিয়ে পাতলা পায়খানা।
    - সতর্কতা: হাইপোক্সিক (অক্সিজেনশূন্য) হার্টে হুট করে এট্রোপিন দিলে ভেন্ট্রিকুলার ফিব্রিলেশন হয়ে রোগী সাথে সাথে মারা যাবে! আগে সাকশন ও ১০০% অক্সিজেন, তারপর এট্রোপিন।
    - এট্রোপিনাইজেশন সাইন: বুক শব্দমুক্ত হওয়া (ফুসফুসে আর কোনো ঘড়ঘড় শব্দ না থাকা) সবচেয়ে প্রধান সাইন।

    OPP CHOLINERGIC CRISIS & ATROPINIZATION
    Toxidrome: D-U-M-B-E-L-S
    Atropinized: Clear Lungs + HR > 80 + Dilated Pupils
    1. Pathogenesis & Clinical Features:
    • Mechanism: Irreversible phosphorylation and inhibition of Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) leading to toxic acetylcholine accumulation.
    • Muscarinic Toxidrome (DUMBELS): Diarrhea, Urination, Miosis (pinpoint pupils), Bronchorrhea & Bradycardia, Emesis, Lacrimation, Salivation (froth at mouth).
    • Nicotinic: Muscle fasciculations, muscle twitching, flaccid weakness.
    2. Emergency Management:
    • Decontamination: Strip contaminated clothes; wash body with soap and water; secure personal protection (PPE).
    • Airway & Oxygen: Clear secretions by suctioning; provide high-flow O₂ before atropine to prevent ventricular fibrillation.
    • Atropine Protocol: IV Atropine 1.8–3 mg stat bolus, double the dose every 5 minutes (3 ➔ 6 ➔ 12 ➔ 24 mg) until fully atropinized.
    • Signs of Full Atropinization: Clear chest (no rhonchi/bronchorrhea), dry axillae/mouth, heart rate > 80–100 bpm, dilated pupils.
    • Cholinesterase Reactivator: Pralidoxime (2-PAM) 1–2 g IV in 100 mL NS over 30 min, then 8 mg/kg/hr infusion.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ইমার্জেন্সি গোল্ড:
    - DUMBELS লক্ষণ: চোখে পিনপয়েন্ট পিউপিল, মুখে লালা/ফেনা, অতিরিক্ত ঘাম, পেটে মোচড় দিয়ে পাতলা পায়খানা।
    - সতর্কতা: হাইপোক্সিক (অক্সিজেনশূন্য) হার্টে হুট করে এট্রোপিন দিলে ভেন্ট্রিকুলার ফিব্রিলেশন হয়ে রোগী সাথে সাথে মারা যাবে! আগে সাকশন ও ১০০% অক্সিজেন, তারপর এট্রোপিন।
    - এট্রোপিনাইজেশন সাইন: বুক শব্দমুক্ত হওয়া (ফুসফুসে আর কোনো ঘড়ঘড় শব্দ না থাকা) সবচেয়ে প্রধান সাইন।

    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

    ★★★★★
    A 55-year-old diabetic gentleman presents to the emergency room with severe crushing retrosternal chest pain radiating to the left jaw and shoulder for 2 hours, associated with sweating and vomiting.
    (a) What is your provisional diagnosis?
    (b) What immediate bedside investigations would you order?
    (c) Outline the immediate and definitive emergency management of Acute ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI).
    (d) Enumerate five early complications of STEMI.**
    40th BCS46th BCS 15 Marks
    QID: #222
    📚 Reference: Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine 24th ed., Ch. 18 (Cardiovascular Disease)
    ACUTE STEMI EMERGENCY TIMELINE
    0-10m: ECG + MONA Protocol ➔ 10-60m: Dual Antiplatelet + Anticoagulation ➔ ≤90m: Primary PCI vs Streptokinase
    1. Diagnosis & Bedside Investigations:
    • Diagnosis: Acute ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI).
    • Immediate Tests: 12-lead ECG (ST elevation ≥ 1 mm in ≥ 2 contiguous leads, or ≥ 2 mm in V2-V3), Cardiac Troponin I/T, CK-MB, bedside Echo, serum electrolytes, serum creatinine, lipid profile.
    2. Step-by-Step Emergency Management:
    • MONA-B Resuscitation: Oxygen (only if SpO₂ < 90%), Sublingual GTN 0.5 mg (avoid in RV infarction/hypotension), IV Morphine 3–5 mg + Metoclopramide 10 mg, Aspirin 300 mg chewed, Ticagrelor 180 mg or Clopidogrel 300–600 mg stat.
    • Reperfusion: Primary PCI (door-to-balloon ≤ 90 min) OR Thrombolysis with IV Streptokinase 1.5 million IU in 100 mL NS over 60 min (door-to-needle ≤ 30 min).
    • Adjunctive Pharmacotherapy: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC 12-hrly, Atorvastatin 80 mg daily, Oral Beta-blocker (Metoprolol 25–50 mg) and ACE-inhibitor (Ramipril 2.5 mg) within 24 hours.
    3. Early Complications:

    Ventricular Fibrillation/VT, Cardiogenic Shock, Acute Mitral Regurgitation, VSR, and Cardiac Tamponade.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - টাইম ইজ মাসল: এমআই-এর রোগী আসা মাত্রই ৩টি ডিসপিরিন (Aspirin 300 mg) চিবিয়ে খেতে দিন + Clopidogrel 4টি (300 mg) + Atorvastatin 80 mg।
    - সতর্কতা: Inferior wall STEMI-তে রাইট ভেন্ট্রিকল আক্রান্ত থাকলে ভুলেও Nitroglycerin দেওয়া যাবে না! দিলে মারাত্মক প্রেশার কমে কার্ডিওজেনিক শক হতে পারে।
    - বাংলাদেশে প্রথম চিকিৎসা: জেলা/উপজেলা লেভেলে PCI না থাকায় Streptokinase 1.5 million IU ইনফিউশন প্রধান উত্তর।

    Detailed examination of Nephrology & Urinary Disorders according to standard textbooks (Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine 24th ed.). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.

    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    A 30-year-old male presents with high fever, retro-orbital pain, severe arthralgia, and maculopapular rash for 4 days. On day 5, his fever subsides, but he develops abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleeding, and cold clammy skin.
    (a) What is your diagnosis?
    (b) Define the critical phase of Dengue illness and mention its clinical warning signs.
    (c) Outline the fluid resuscitation protocol for Dengue Shock Syndrome according to national guidelines.**
    40th BCS45th BCS 15 Marks
    QID: #253
    📚 Reference: National Guidelines for Clinical Management of Dengue Syndrome Bangladesh / WHO
    DENGUE CLINICAL PHASES & FLUID REGIMEN
    Febrile Phase (Days 1-4) ➔ Critical Phase (Days 4-7, Plasma Leak) ➔ Recovery Phase (Fluid Reabsorption)
    1. Clinical Phases & Warning Signs:
    • Critical Phase: Occurs when fever subsides (around Day 4–6), lasting 24–48 hours; characterized by capillary leakage leading to hemoconcentration and shock.
    • Warning Signs: Severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleeding, lethargy/restlessness, hepatomegaly > 2 cm, rising Hematocrit (HCT ≥ 20% increase) with rapid drop in platelets (< 100,000/μL).
    2. Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS) Fluid Resuscitation Protocol:
    • Compensated Shock: Start IV Ringer's Lactate / 0.9% Normal Saline at 5–10 mL/kg/hr over 1 hour. If improving, reduce gradually to 5–7 ➔ 3–5 ➔ 2–3 mL/kg/hr.
    • Decompensated / Hypotensive Shock: Bolus 10–20 mL/kg of crystalloid over 15–30 minutes. If no improvement, infuse 10–20 mL/kg of colloid (Dextran 40 / 6% HES).
    • Caution: Stop fluids immediately in recovery phase to prevent pulmonary edema!
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও চিকিৎসকের সতর্কতা:
    - সবচেয়ে বিপজ্জনক সময়: যখন জ্বর ছাড়ে (Day 4–6), তখনই ক্রcritical phase শুরু হয়! প্লাজমা লিক হয়ে রক্তনালী শুকিয়ে শক হয়।
    - হেমাটোক্রিট (HCT) হলো কম্পাস: ডেঙ্গুতে প্লাটিলেটের চেয়েও হেমাটোক্রিট বেশি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। HCT বাড়লে ফ্লুইড বাড়াতে হবে, কমলে কমাতে হবে।
    - কখন ফ্লুইড বন্ধ করবেন? ৪৮ ঘণ্টা ক্রিটিক্যাল ফেইজ পার হলে রোগী সুস্থ হতে শুরু করে, তখন অতিরিক্ত স্যালাইন দিলে ফুসফুসে পানি জমে (Pulmonary Edema) রোগী মারা যেতে পারে।

    Write short notes on: Cholera: Stool characteristics, assessment of severe dehydration, and rehydration with IV fluids + azithromycin
    40th BCS 6 Marks
    QID: #258
    📚 Reference: Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics 21st ed., Ch. 338 / WHO Diarrhea Management Guidelines
    WHO DEHYDRATION CLASSIFICATION & PROTOCOL
    Plan A: No Dehydration
    Home fluids + ORS + Zinc
    Plan B: Some Dehydration
    ORS 75 mL/kg over 4 hrs
    Plan C: Severe Dehydration
    IV Cholera Saline 100 mL/kg
    1. Assessment of Dehydration:
    • No Dehydration: Alert, normal eyes/tears, drinks normally, skin pinch goes back quickly.
    • Some Dehydration: Restless/irritable, sunken eyes, drinks eagerly/thirsty, skin pinch goes back slowly (< 2 sec).
    • Severe Dehydration: Lethargic/unconscious, very sunken eyes, unable to drink/drinks poorly, skin pinch goes back very slowly (> 2 sec).
    2. WHO Treatment Plans:
    • Plan A (Home Care): Extra home fluids, give ORS after each loose stool (50–100 mL if < 2y; 100–200 mL if ≥ 2y), continue feeding, Zinc 20 mg daily for 14 days (10 mg if < 6m).
    • Plan B (Oral Rehydration in Health Facility): ORS 75 mL/kg over 4 hours. Reassess after 4 hours.
    • Plan C (Emergency IV Resuscitation for Severe Dehydration): IV Cholera Saline / Ringer's Lactate 100 mL/kg:
      - Infants (< 1 year): 30 mL/kg in 1st hour, then 70 mL/kg over next 5 hours (Total 6 hrs).
      - Older Children: 30 mL/kg in 1st 30 minutes, then 70 mL/kg over next 2.5 hours (Total 3 hrs).
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - প্ল্যান-সি ফ্লুইড হিসাব: মোট ১০০ মিলি/কেজি। বাচ্চার বয়স ১ বছরের নিচে হলে ৬ ঘণ্টায় দিতে হবে (৩০ মিলি ১ম ঘণ্টায়, বাকি ৭০ মিলি পরবর্তী ৫ ঘণ্টায়)। ১ বছরের বড় হলে ৩ ঘণ্টায় দিতে হবে (৩০ মিলি আধা ঘণ্টায়, বাকি ৭০ মিলি আড়াই ঘণ্টায়)।
    - জিংক দেওয়া বাধ্যতামূলক: ডায়রিয়ায় জিংক দিলে অন্ত্রের ভিলি দ্রুত সুস্থ হয় ও পরবর্তী ২-৩ মাস ডায়রিয়ার ঝুঁকি কমে। ৬ মাসের নিচে ১০ মি.গ্রা., উপরে ২০ মি.গ্রা. করে টানা ১৪ দিন দিতে হবে।

    1. Anatomical / Physiological / Pathological Basis:

    Detailed examination of Endocrinology & Metabolism according to standard textbooks (Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine 24th ed.). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - Hematology টপিকের মূল ভাব: বিসিএস লিখিত পরীক্ষায় এই প্রশ্নের উত্তর লেখার সময় সুন্দর পয়েন্ট ও সাব-হেডিং ব্যবহার করুন।

    ★★★★★
    A 30-year-old worker sustains flame burns over the anterior chest, abdomen, and both upper limbs.
    (a) Calculate the percentage of Total Body Surface Area (TBSA) burned using Wallace's Rule of Nines.
    (b) Describe the criteria for hospital admission of a burn patient.
    (c) Calculate fluid requirements during the first 24 hours using the Parkland formula.
    (d) Enumerate complications of severe burns.**
    41st BCS45th BCS 15 Marks
    QID: #288
    📚 Reference: Bailey & Love's Short Practice of Surgery 28th ed., Ch. 25 (Burns)
    PARKLAND (BAXTER) RESUSCITATION FORMULA
    Total Fluid (24 hrs) = 4 mL × Weight (kg) × % TBSA Burned (Ringer's Lactate)
    1st 8 Hours: 50% of total | Next 16 Hours: Remaining 50%
    1. Calculation of Burn Percentage (Wallace Rule of Nines):

    Head/Neck = 9%, Anterior Trunk = 18%, Posterior Trunk = 18%, Each Upper Limb = 9% (x2=18%), Each Lower Limb = 18% (x2=36%), Perineum = 1%. Total = 100%.

    2. Parkland Formula Resuscitation:
    • Fluid of Choice: Ringer's Lactate.
    • Formula: 4 mL × Body Weight (kg) × % TBSA burned.
    • Administration Schedule: Give 50% in the first 8 hours (calculated from the exact time of injury), and the remaining 50% over the next 16 hours.
    • Monitoring Endpoint: Maintain adult urine output at 0.5 to 1.0 mL/kg/hour (30–50 mL/hr).
    3. Early & Late Complications:

    Hypovolemic shock, Inhalation injury, Burn wound sepsis (Pseudomonas), Curling's stress ulcer, Contractures, Marjolin's ulcer (SCC).

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও অংক করার ট্রিকস:
    - ৮ ঘণ্টার হিসাব: রোগী হাসপাতালে আসার সময় থেকে নয়, দুর্ঘটনা ঘটার মুহূর্ত থেকে ৮ ঘণ্টার মধ্যে মোট ফ্লুইডের অর্ধেক শেষ করতে হবে!
    - সেরা ফ্লুইড: সব সময় Ringer's Lactate (হার্টম্যান সল্যুশন)। Normal Saline দিলে এসিডোসিস হতে পারে।
    - মনিটরিং: প্রস্রাব মেপে দেখতে হবে ঘণ্টায় ৩০–৫০ মিলি হচ্ছে কি না।

    • Formula: 4 mL × Body Weight (kg) × % TBSA burned.
    • Administration Schedule: Give 50% in the first 8 hours (calculated from the exact time of injury), and the remaining 50% over the next 16 hours.
    • Monitoring Endpoint: Maintain adult urine output at 0.5 to 1.0 mL/kg/hour (30–50 mL/hr).
    3. Early & Late Complications:

    Hypovolemic shock, Inhalation injury, Burn wound sepsis (Pseudomonas), Curling's stress ulcer, Contractures, Marjolin's ulcer (SCC).

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও অংক করার ট্রিকস:
    - ৮ ঘণ্টার হিসাব: রোগী হাসপাতালে আসার সময় থেকে নয়, দুর্ঘটনা ঘটার মুহূর্ত থেকে ৮ ঘণ্টার মধ্যে মোট ফ্লুইডের অর্ধেক শেষ করতে হবে!
    - সেরা ফ্লুইড: সব সময় Ringer's Lactate (হার্টম্যান সল্যুশন)। Normal Saline দিলে এসিডোসিস হতে পারে।
    - মনিটরিং: প্রস্রাব মেপে দেখতে হবে ঘণ্টায় ৩০–৫০ মিলি হচ্ছে কি না।

    Etiology & Structural Basis ➔ Pathophysiology & Presentation ➔ Diagnostic Tests & Gold Standard ➔ Evidence-Based Management
    1. Anatomical / Physiological / Pathological Basis:

    Detailed examination of Antenatal Care & High-Risk Pregnancy according to standard textbooks (DC Dutta's Textbook of Obstetrics & Gynaecology 9th ed.). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    ★★★★★
    Define Preeclampsia. Differentiate between gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, and chronic hypertension. What are the clinical and laboratory features of Preeclampsia with severe features?
    40th BCS44th BCS 10 Marks
    QID: #322
    📚 Reference: DC Dutta's Textbook of Obstetrics 9th ed., Ch. 17 (Hypertensive Disorders in Pregnancy)
    PRITCHARD REGIMEN FLOWCHART
    Loading: 4g IV (20%) + 10g IM (50%) ➔ Check: Knee Jerk (+) | RR ≥ 16 | Urine ≥ 30 ml/hr ➔ Maint: 5g IM 4-hrly alternate buttock
    1. Diagnosis & Emergency Resuscitation:
    • Diagnosis: Antepartum Eclampsia at 36 weeks of gestation in a primigravida.
    • Airway & Breathing: Place patient in left lateral tilt; insert mouth gag to prevent tongue bite; suction secretions; high-flow O₂ (8–10 L/min).
    • Circulation & Access: Two 16G/18G IV lines; Foley catheter with urometer for hourly urine output.
    2. Magnesium Sulfate (MgSO₄) Pritchard Protocol:
    • Loading Dose (14 g): 4 g IV (20% solution) slowly over 10–15 min PLUS 10 g IM (50% solution, 5 g deep in each buttock with 1 mL 2% lignocaine).
    • Maintenance Dose: 5 g IM (50% solution) into alternate buttocks every 4 hours, continuing for 24 hours after last convulsion or delivery.
    • Mandatory Pre-Dose Checks: Patellar reflex present, Respiratory rate ≥ 16/min, Urine output ≥ 30 mL/hr (≥ 100 mL/4 hrs).
    • Antidote for Toxicity: IV 10% Calcium Gluconate 10 mL given slowly over 10 minutes.
    3. Definitive Management:

    Delivery of the fetus and placenta within 6–12 hours once maternal vitals and seizures are stabilized.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - লোডিং ডোজে ১৪ গ্রাম: ৪ গ্রাম রক্তনালীতে (IV) আর ১০ গ্রাম দুই পাশের বাটকে ৫ গ্রাম করে (IM)।
    - ৩টি পূর্বশর্ত (K-R-U): Knee jerk থাকতে হবে, RR ১৬ এর বেশি এবং Urine output ঘণ্টায় ৩০ মিলি বা তার বেশি হতে হবে।
    - এন্টিডোট: 10% Calcium Gluconate 10 ml IV stat (ধীরে ধীরে ১০ মিনিটে)।

    Define Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH). Differentiate between primary and secondary PPH.
    (a) Enumerate the 4Ts etiologies of PPH (Tone, Tissue, Trauma, Thrombin).
    (b) Describe the components of Active Management of the Third Stage of Labor (AMTSL).
    (c) Detail the stepwise medical (Oxytocin, Ergometrine, Misoprostol, Tranexamic acid) and surgical/balloon tamponade management of Atonic PPH.**
    41st BCS45th BCS 15 Marks
    QID: #328
    📚 Reference: DC Dutta's Textbook of Obstetrics 9th ed., Ch. 28 (Postpartum Hemorrhage)
    THE 4Ts OF PPH & STEPWISE MANAGEMENT
    Tone (70% - Atony) Trauma (20% - Tears) Tissue (10% - Retained) Thrombin (1% - DIC)
    1. Definition & 4Ts Etiology:
    • Definition: Blood loss ≥ 500 mL following vaginal delivery or ≥ 1000 mL after cesarean section within 24 hours (Primary PPH).
    • Etiology (4Ts): Tone (Uterine atony, 70%), Trauma (Cervical/vaginal lacerations, 20%), Tissue (Retained placenta/cotyledon, 10%), Thrombin (Coagulopathy/DIC, 1%).
    2. Active Management of Third Stage of Labor (AMTSL):
    1. Uterotonic: Inj. Oxytocin 10 IU IM within 1 minute of fetal delivery.
    2. Controlled Cord Traction (CCT) (Brandt-Andrews technique) with counter-traction on the uterus.
    3. Uterine massage immediately following placental expulsion and every 15 min for 2 hours.
    3. Stepwise Emergency Protocol for Atonic PPH:
    • Resuscitation: Call for help; 2 wide-bore IV cannulae (16G); rapid infusion of Ringer's lactate; crossmatch 4 units whole blood; bimanual uterine compression.
    • Uterotonics: Oxytocin 20–40 IU in 500 mL NS (IV infusion); Ergometrine 0.25 mg IM/IV (avoid in hypertension); Misoprostol 800–1000 mcg per rectum; Tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 min.
    • Tamponade & Surgery: Condom-catheter intrauterine balloon tamponade (fill with 300–500 mL warm saline); B-Lynch brace compression sutures; Bilateral internal iliac artery ligation; Subtotal/Total Hysterectomy as last resort.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও প্র্যাকটিক্যাল টিপস:
    - ৪টি 'T' মনে রাখুন: Tone (জরায়ু নরম/শিথিল), Trauma (ছেঁড়াফাটা), Tissue (গর্ভফুল আটকে থাকা), Thrombin (রক্ত জমাট না বাঁধা)।
    - AMTSL-এর ৩ ধাপ: বাচ্চা হওয়ার ১ মিনিটের মধ্যে ১০ ইউনিট অক্সিটোসিন মাংসপেশিতে + কর্ড ধরে সঠিক ট্র্যাকশন (CCT) + জরায়ু ম্যাসাজ।
    - কনডম ক্যাথেটার বেলুন টেম্পোনেড: ওষুধে কাজ না হলে এটি জীবন বাঁচায়—একটি ইউরিনারি ক্যাথেটারে কনডম বেঁধে জরায়ুতে ঢুকিয়ে ৩০০–৫০০ মিলি নরমাল স্যালাইন দিয়ে ফুলিয়ে দিতে হয়।

    ★★★
    Write short notes on: Condom-catheter balloon tamponade: Indication, construction, and mechanism in refractory atonic PPH
    43rd BCS 6 Marks
    QID: #329
    📚 Reference: DC Dutta's Textbook of Obstetrics 9th ed., Ch. 28 (Postpartum Hemorrhage)
    THE 4Ts OF PPH & STEPWISE MANAGEMENT
    Tone (70% - Atony) Trauma (20% - Tears) Tissue (10% - Retained) Thrombin (1% - DIC)
    1. Definition & 4Ts Etiology:
    • Definition: Blood loss ≥ 500 mL following vaginal delivery or ≥ 1000 mL after cesarean section within 24 hours (Primary PPH).
    • Etiology (4Ts): Tone (Uterine atony, 70%), Trauma (Cervical/vaginal lacerations, 20%), Tissue (Retained placenta/cotyledon, 10%), Thrombin (Coagulopathy/DIC, 1%).
    2. Active Management of Third Stage of Labor (AMTSL):
    1. Uterotonic: Inj. Oxytocin 10 IU IM within 1 minute of fetal delivery.
    2. Controlled Cord Traction (CCT) (Brandt-Andrews technique) with counter-traction on the uterus.
    3. Uterine massage immediately following placental expulsion and every 15 min for 2 hours.
    3. Stepwise Emergency Protocol for Atonic PPH:
    • Resuscitation: Call for help; 2 wide-bore IV cannulae (16G); rapid infusion of Ringer's lactate; crossmatch 4 units whole blood; bimanual uterine compression.
    • Uterotonics: Oxytocin 20–40 IU in 500 mL NS (IV infusion); Ergometrine 0.25 mg IM/IV (avoid in hypertension); Misoprostol 800–1000 mcg per rectum; Tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 min.
    • Tamponade & Surgery: Condom-catheter intrauterine balloon tamponade (fill with 300–500 mL warm saline); B-Lynch brace compression sutures; Bilateral internal iliac artery ligation; Subtotal/Total Hysterectomy as last resort.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও প্র্যাকটিক্যাল টিপস:

In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    Etiology & Structural Basis ➔ Pathophysiology & Presentation ➔ Diagnostic Tests & Gold Standard ➔ Evidence-Based Management
    1. Anatomical / Physiological / Pathological Basis:

    Detailed examination of Neonatology & Neonatal Resuscitation according to standard textbooks (Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics 21st ed. / MR Khan). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - Neonatology & Neonatal Resuscitation টপিকের মূল ভাব: বিসিএস লিখিত পরীক্ষায় এই প্রশ্নের উত্তর লেখার সময় সুন্দর পয়েন্ট ও সাব-হেডিং ব্যবহার করুন।
    - পরীক্ষকের প্রত্যাশা: অ্যানাটমি বা ফিজিওলজি হলে অবশ্যই একটি পরিষ্কার চিহ্নিত চিত্র (Labeled Diagram) আঁকবেন; মেডিসিন বা সার্জারি হলে ধাপে ধাপে ট্রিটমেন্ট প্রটোকল লিখবেন।
    - নম্বর তোলার কৌশল: মূল মেডিকেল টার্মিনোলজি ও ড্রাগের নাম ইংরেজিতে বোল্ড করে উপস্থাপন করলে সর্বোচ্চ নম্বর পাওয়া যায়।

    ★★★★★
    A 14-month-old child presents with frequent watery stools and vomiting for 2 days.
    (a) Describe the clinical assessment of Dehydration according to WHO guidelines (No dehydration, Some dehydration, Severe dehydration).
    (b) Outline WHO Treatment Plan A, Plan B, and Plan C for acute watery diarrhea.
    (c) What is the role of Oral Rehydration Salts (low-osmolarity ORS) and Zinc supplementation in children with diarrhea?**
    40th BCS45th BCS 15 Marks
    QID: #367
    📚 Reference: Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics 21st ed., Ch. 338 / WHO Diarrhea Management Guidelines
    WHO DEHYDRATION CLASSIFICATION & PROTOCOL
    Plan A: No Dehydration
    Home fluids + ORS + Zinc
    Plan B: Some Dehydration
    ORS 75 mL/kg over 4 hrs
    Plan C: Severe Dehydration
    IV Cholera Saline 100 mL/kg
    1. Assessment of Dehydration:
    • No Dehydration: Alert, normal eyes/tears, drinks normally, skin pinch goes back quickly.
    • Some Dehydration: Restless/irritable, sunken eyes, drinks eagerly/thirsty, skin pinch goes back slowly (< 2 sec).
    • Severe Dehydration: Lethargic/unconscious, very sunken eyes, unable to drink/drinks poorly, skin pinch goes back very slowly (> 2 sec).
    2. WHO Treatment Plans:
    • Plan A (Home Care): Extra home fluids, give ORS after each loose stool (50–100 mL if < 2y; 100–200 mL if ≥ 2y), continue feeding, Zinc 20 mg daily for 14 days (10 mg if < 6m).
    • Plan B (Oral Rehydration in Health Facility): ORS 75 mL/kg over 4 hours. Reassess after 4 hours.
    • Plan C (Emergency IV Resuscitation for Severe Dehydration): IV Cholera Saline / Ringer's Lactate 100 mL/kg:
      - Infants (< 1 year): 30 mL/kg in 1st hour, then 70 mL/kg over next 5 hours (Total 6 hrs).
      - Older Children: 30 mL/kg in 1st 30 minutes, then 70 mL/kg over next 2.5 hours (Total 3 hrs).
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - প্ল্যান-সি ফ্লুইড হিসাব: মোট ১০০ মিলি/কেজি। বাচ্চার বয়স ১ বছরের নিচে হলে ৬ ঘণ্টায় দিতে হবে (৩০ মিলি ১ম ঘণ্টায়, বাকি ৭০ মিলি পরবর্তী ৫ ঘণ্টায়)। ১ বছরের বড় হলে ৩ ঘণ্টায় দিতে হবে (৩০ মিলি আধা ঘণ্টায়, বাকি ৭০ মিলি আড়াই ঘণ্টায়)।
    - জিংক দেওয়া বাধ্যতামূলক: ডায়রিয়ায় জিংক দিলে অন্ত্রের ভিলি দ্রুত সুস্থ হয় ও পরবর্তী ২-৩ মাস ডায়রিয়ার ঝুঁকি কমে। ৬ মাসের নিচে ১০ মি.গ্রা., উপরে ২০ মি.গ্রা. করে টানা ১৪ দিন দিতে হবে।

    41st BCS45th BCS 12 Marks
    QID: #368
    📚 Reference: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 26th ed., Ch. 4 / National EPI Guidelines Bangladesh
    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

    CLINICAL CONCEPT & FLOWCHART SCHEMATIC: PEDIATRIC INFECTIOUS & RESPIRATORY DISEASES
    Etiology & Structural Basis ➔ Pathophysiology & Presentation ➔ Diagnostic Tests & Gold Standard ➔ Evidence-Based Management
    1. Anatomical / Physiological / Pathological Basis:

    Detailed examination of Pediatric Infectious & Respiratory Diseases according to standard textbooks (Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics 21st ed. / MR Khan). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    Write short notes on: Dengue infection in children: Warning signs and pediatric fluid calculation
    45th BCS 6 Marks
    QID: #371
    📚 Reference: National Guidelines for Clinical Management of Dengue Syndrome Bangladesh / WHO
    DENGUE CLINICAL PHASES & FLUID REGIMEN
    Febrile Phase (Days 1-4) ➔ Critical Phase (Days 4-7, Plasma Leak) ➔ Recovery Phase (Fluid Reabsorption)
    1. Clinical Phases & Warning Signs:
    • Critical Phase: Occurs when fever subsides (around Day 4–6), lasting 24–48 hours; characterized by capillary leakage leading to hemoconcentration and shock.
    • Warning Signs: Severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleeding, lethargy/restlessness, hepatomegaly > 2 cm, rising Hematocrit (HCT ≥ 20% increase) with rapid drop in platelets (< 100,000/μL).
    2. Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS) Fluid Resuscitation Protocol:
    • Compensated Shock: Start IV Ringer's Lactate / 0.9% Normal Saline at 5–10 mL/kg/hr over 1 hour. If improving, reduce gradually to 5–7 ➔ 3–5 ➔ 2–3 mL/kg/hr.
    • Decompensated / Hypotensive Shock: Bolus 10–20 mL/kg of crystalloid over 15–30 minutes. If no improvement, infuse 10–20 mL/kg of colloid (Dextran 40 / 6% HES).
    • Caution: Stop fluids immediately in recovery phase to prevent pulmonary edema!
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও চিকিৎসকের সতর্কতা:
    - সবচেয়ে বিপজ্জনক সময়: যখন জ্বর ছাড়ে (Day 4–6), তখনই ক্রcritical phase শুরু হয়! প্লাজমা লিক হয়ে রক্তনালী শুকিয়ে শক হয়।
    - হেমাটোক্রিট (HCT) হলো কম্পাস: ডেঙ্গুতে প্লাটিলেটের চেয়েও হেমাটোক্রিট বেশি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। HCT বাড়লে ফ্লুইড বাড়াতে হবে, কমলে কমাতে হবে।
    - কখন ফ্লুইড বন্ধ করবেন? ৪৮ ঘণ্টা ক্রিটিক্যাল ফেইজ পার হলে রোগী সুস্থ হতে শুরু করে, তখন অতিরিক্ত স্যালাইন দিলে ফুসফুসে পানি জমে (Pulmonary Edema) রোগী মারা যেতে পারে।

In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.

    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    📚 Reference: Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine 24th ed., Ch. 18 (Cardiovascular Disease)
    ACUTE STEMI EMERGENCY TIMELINE
    0-10m: ECG + MONA Protocol ➔ 10-60m: Dual Antiplatelet + Anticoagulation ➔ ≤90m: Primary PCI vs Streptokinase
    1. Diagnosis & Bedside Investigations:
    • Diagnosis: Acute ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI).
    • Immediate Tests: 12-lead ECG (ST elevation ≥ 1 mm in ≥ 2 contiguous leads, or ≥ 2 mm in V2-V3), Cardiac Troponin I/T, CK-MB, bedside Echo, serum electrolytes, serum creatinine, lipid profile.
    2. Step-by-Step Emergency Management:
    • MONA-B Resuscitation: Oxygen (only if SpO₂ < 90%), Sublingual GTN 0.5 mg (avoid in RV infarction/hypotension), IV Morphine 3–5 mg + Metoclopramide 10 mg, Aspirin 300 mg chewed, Ticagrelor 180 mg or Clopidogrel 300–600 mg stat.
    • Reperfusion: Primary PCI (door-to-balloon ≤ 90 min) OR Thrombolysis with IV Streptokinase 1.5 million IU in 100 mL NS over 60 min (door-to-needle ≤ 30 min).
    • Adjunctive Pharmacotherapy: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC 12-hrly, Atorvastatin 80 mg daily, Oral Beta-blocker (Metoprolol 25–50 mg) and ACE-inhibitor (Ramipril 2.5 mg) within 24 hours.
    3. Early Complications:

    Ventricular Fibrillation/VT, Cardiogenic Shock, Acute Mitral Regurgitation, VSR, and Cardiac Tamponade.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - টাইম ইজ মাসল: এমআই-এর রোগী আসা মাত্রই ৩টি ডিসপিরিন (Aspirin 300 mg) চিবিয়ে খেতে দিন + Clopidogrel 4টি (300 mg) + Atorvastatin 80 mg।
    - সতর্কতা: Inferior wall STEMI-তে রাইট ভেন্ট্রিকল আক্রান্ত থাকলে ভুলেও Nitroglycerin দেওয়া যাবে না! দিলে মারাত্মক প্রেশার কমে কার্ডিওজেনিক শক হতে পারে।
    - বাংলাদেশে প্রথম চিকিৎসা: জেলা/উপজেলা লেভেলে PCI না থাকায় Streptokinase 1.5 million IU ইনফিউশন প্রধান উত্তর।

    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.

    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    ★★★★
    Describe the characteristics of Firearm Wounds: Entry wound vs Exit wound, differences between contact, close-range, and distant gunshot wounds (burning, blackening, tattooing).
    43rd BCS 10 Marks
    QID: #392
    📚 Reference: Bailey & Love's Short Practice of Surgery 28th ed., Ch. 25 (Burns)
    PARKLAND (BAXTER) RESUSCITATION FORMULA
    Total Fluid (24 hrs) = 4 mL × Weight (kg) × % TBSA Burned (Ringer's Lactate)
    1st 8 Hours: 50% of total | Next 16 Hours: Remaining 50%
    1. Calculation of Burn Percentage (Wallace Rule of Nines):

    Head/Neck = 9%, Anterior Trunk = 18%, Posterior Trunk = 18%, Each Upper Limb = 9% (x2=18%), Each Lower Limb = 18% (x2=36%), Perineum = 1%. Total = 100%.

    2. Parkland Formula Resuscitation:
    • Fluid of Choice: Ringer's Lactate.
    • Formula: 4 mL × Body Weight (kg) × % TBSA burned.
    • Administration Schedule: Give 50% in the first 8 hours (calculated from the exact time of injury), and the remaining 50% over the next 16 hours.
    • Monitoring Endpoint: Maintain adult urine output at 0.5 to 1.0 mL/kg/hour (30–50 mL/hr).
    3. Early & Late Complications:

    Hypovolemic shock, Inhalation injury, Burn wound sepsis (Pseudomonas), Curling's stress ulcer, Contractures, Marjolin's ulcer (SCC).

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও অংক করার ট্রিকস:
    - ৮ ঘণ্টার হিসাব: রোগী হাসপাতালে আসার সময় থেকে নয়, দুর্ঘটনা ঘটার মুহূর্ত থেকে ৮ ঘণ্টার মধ্যে মোট ফ্লুইডের অর্ধেক শেষ করতে হবে!
    - সেরা ফ্লুইড: সব সময় Ringer's Lactate (হার্টম্যান সল্যুশন)। Normal Saline দিলে এসিডোসিস হতে পারে।
    - মনিটরিং: প্রস্রাব মেপে দেখতে হবে ঘণ্টায় ৩০–৫০ মিলি হচ্ছে কি না।

    CLINICAL CONCEPT & FLOWCHART SCHEMATIC: MEDICAL JURISPRUDENCE, CONSENT & ETHICS
    Etiology & Structural Basis ➔ Pathophysiology & Presentation ➔ Diagnostic Tests & Gold Standard ➔ Evidence-Based Management
    1. Anatomical / Physiological / Pathological Basis:

    Detailed examination of Medical Jurisprudence, Consent & Ethics according to standard textbooks (Parikh's Textbook of Medical Jurisprudence, Forensic Medicine and Toxicology). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - Medical Jurisprudence, Consent & Ethics টপিকের মূল ভাব: বিসিএস লিখিত পরীক্ষায় এই প্রশ্নের উত্তর লেখার সময় সুন্দর পয়েন্ট ও সাব-হেডিং ব্যবহার করুন।

    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

    CLINICAL CONCEPT & FLOWCHART SCHEMATIC: EPIDEMIOLOGY & BIOSTATISTICS
    Etiology & Structural Basis ➔ Pathophysiology & Presentation ➔ Diagnostic Tests & Gold Standard ➔ Evidence-Based Management
    1. Anatomical / Physiological / Pathological Basis:

    Detailed examination of Epidemiology & Biostatistics according to standard textbooks (Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 26th ed.). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.
    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও এক্সাম টিপস:
    - Epidemiology & Biostatistics টপিকের মূল ভাব: বিসিএস লিখিত পরীক্ষায় এই প্রশ্নের উত্তর লেখার সময় সুন্দর পয়েন্ট ও সাব-হেডিং ব্যবহার করুন।

    ★★★★★
    Describe the National Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI) strategy of Bangladesh. Detail the logistics of the Cold Chain: Equipment used at central, district, and upazila levels, maintenance of +2°C to +8°C temperature, and management of Cold Chain breakdown.
    40th BCS45th BCS 12 Marks
    QID: #430
    📚 Reference: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 26th ed., Ch. 4 / National EPI Guidelines Bangladesh
    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।

    Detailed examination of Environmental Health, Sanitation & Water Safety according to standard textbooks (Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 26th ed.). In the Bangladesh Civil Service examination, full marks require precise definition, anatomical relations or physiological pathways, and clear clinical correlation.

    • Core Definition & Architecture: Systematic breakdown of structural components, boundaries, cellular layers, or biochemical pathways.
    • Functional Mechanism: Hemodynamics, enzymatic cascades, regulatory feedback mechanisms, or neurovascular supply.
    2. Diagnostic Workup & Clinical Presentation:
    • Bedside Clinical Assessment: Cardinal symptoms, physical inspection, palpation findings, and classic named diagnostic clinical signs.
    • Laboratory & Imaging Modalities: Baseline investigations, gold standard confirmatory assays, histological criteria, or radiological imaging.
    3. Stepwise Management & Surgical / Pharmacological Approach:
    1. Immediate Resuscitation: Hemodynamic stabilization, airway security, oxygenation, and intravenous access.
    2. Definitive Pharmacotherapy / Surgical Technique: First-line drug regimens with exact dosages, contraindications, and operative indications.
    3. Monitoring & Complications Prevention: Critical vitals tracking, prevention of systemic sequelae, and follow-up criteria.

    41st BCS45th BCS 12 Marks
    QID: #442
    📚 Reference: Park's Textbook of Preventive and Social Medicine 26th ed., Ch. 4 / National EPI Guidelines Bangladesh
    BANGLADESH EPI VACCINE SCHEDULE (< 1 YEAR)
    Birth: BCG (ID, Left Arm) 6, 10, 14w: Penta, bOPV, PCV 14w: fIPV (ID, Right Arm) 9 & 15m: MR-1 & MR-2
    1. 10 Targeted Diseases:

    Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Hepatitis B, Hib, Polio, Pneumococcal disease, Measles, Rubella.

    2. Infant Schedule Table:
    • BCG: At birth, 0.05 mL, Intradermal (ID), Left upper arm (deltoid).
    • Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib): 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral left thigh.
    • bOPV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 2 drops, Oral.
    • PCV: 6, 10, 14 weeks, 0.5 mL, IM, Anterolateral right thigh.
    • fIPV: 14 weeks (and 6 weeks), 0.1 mL, ID, Right upper arm.
    • MR-1 & MR-2: 9 months and 15 months, 0.5 mL, Subcutaneous (SC), Right upper arm.
    3. Contraindications:

    Severe anaphylaxis to previous dose; live vaccines in severe congenital/acquired immunodeficiency. Mild fever or cough is NOT a contraindication.

    💡 বাংলা হেল্প নোট ও ছক মনে রাখার ট্রিকস:
    - বাম হাত (ID): BCG (0.05 ml)।
    - বাম উরু (IM): পেন্টাভ্যালেন্ট (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান উরু (IM): PCV (0.5 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (ID): fIPV (0.1 ml)।
    - ডান হাত (SC): MR ভ্যাকসিন (0.5 ml)।
    - মুখ (Oral): bOPV (২ ফোঁটা)।
